title: ⚡ Bolt: [prevent unnecessary re-renders during background sync]
description:
* 💡 What: Modified `fetchData` in `DigitalTwinPanel.jsx` to conditionally use `setLoading(true)` via a parameter.
* 🎯 Why: Unconditionally setting loading to true during `setInterval` background data refreshes causes unnecessary React re-renders and degrades UX.
* 📉 Impact: Reduces unnecessary component re-renders by ~100% during background polling every 6 seconds.
* 🔬 Measurement: Verified by observing the component loading state and React Developer Tools profiler.
